profile_text.body:
Meta is a publicly traded company (NASDAQ: META) founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA. Its website, llama.com, presents the company as a platform for AI developers, offering access to its models and tools through the Meta Model API, which is described as compatible with existing OpenAI SDK clients. The site highlights several products: Muse Spark, a coding-optimized model that the company describes as competitive with the best for coding agents and review bots; Muse Code, a coding agent built to run Muse Spark; and Muse Glimmer, a 30-billion-parameter open model optimized for local agent workflows and small enough to run on a consumer GPU. The site also describes multi-agent workflow capabilities and a search grounding tool that gives models live web access. Meta's tracked AI product is Llama, an open-weight model family commonly self-hosted. The company reported revenue of $200,966,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2025, per its 10-K filing.

Meta faces three tracked legal cases. In Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. and Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc., both filed in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California, the company is a defendant. A third case, Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc., is pending in the Western District of Texas. Several third-party MCP servers built around Meta's advertising infrastructure also appear in the registry, including tools for campaign management, creative testing, and performance analysis across Facebook and Instagram.
